num_nodes: <int> Number of nodes in the directed network.
num_arcs: <int> Number of directed arcs in the network.
num_commodities: <int> Number of commodities to be shipped through the network.
arcs: <list[list[int]], shape [num_arcs][2]> Each arc as a pair [from_node, to_node] representing a directed connection between two nodes.
fixed_costs: <dict, key: '{from_node}_{to_node}'> One-time installation cost incurred if the arc is opened for use.
variable_costs: <dict, key: '{from_node}_{to_node}', value: list[int], length num_commodities> Per-unit transportation cost for routing each commodity along the arc.

commodities.origin: <int> Node where this commodity's shipment originates.
commodities.destination: <int> Node where this commodity's shipment must be delivered.
commodities.demand: <int> Total quantity of this commodity that must be shipped from origin to destination.
